final: WITH status_totals AS (SELECT sites.healtheval AS status, SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scancount, SUM(scans.gbsize) / SUM(scans.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.healtheval), rates AS (SELECT status, total_scancount, rate, AVG(rate) OVER () AS avg_rate FROM status_totals) SELECT status, total_scancount, rate, rate - avg_rate AS rate_minus_average FROM rates WHERE rate > avg_rate
